Welcome to Neon Datalane—an electrifying, futuristic ML competition visualization! Watch rival AI teams sprint through simulated data lanes, use quantum-inspired training boosts, and battle for the top spot on a live accuracy/speed leaderboard.

- Real-time “lane hazards” that test robustness

Comment your pick for the winner and subscribe for the next AI race drop.
